verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip with a PyTorch and DeepSpeed software stack. A user-defined event-to-action rules engine is a workflow or SaaS automation capability, which falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Gaudi shipping such a capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
